# Dagger: a short broad blade 0.3 m, a brass guard, a dark grip. Grip at the origin, blade up. Generated by make_env.py.
new
material new Blade --base-color 0.7020 0.7647 0.5725 --no-slot
material new Guard --base-color 0.6392 0.6078 0.4235 --no-slot
material new Grip --base-color 0.1451 0.1647 0.1765 --no-slot
add mesh cube --name Grip --size 1 --location 0.000 0.000 0.000
scale 0.070 0.070 0.140
apply --scale
material assign Grip
add mesh cube --name Guard --size 1 --location 0.000 0.000 0.090
scale 0.200 0.080 0.060
apply --scale
material assign Guard
add mesh cone --name Blade --vertices 4 --radius1 0.07 --radius2 0.02 --depth 0.3 --location 0 0 0.27
set rotation 0 0 45
apply --rotation
scale 1 0.55 1
apply --scale
material assign Blade
select all
shade flat
export dagger.glb
